lexiconName: Pakistan Legal & Editorial Pitman Shorthand Lexicon
system: Pitman New Era / Superior Judiciary Standard

entries.ruleNote: Upward El-Ar-En is halved to add -D (learned), then intersected across the stem by Kay-En-S-El (counsel) to eliminate pen-lift gaps.
entries.legalDefinition: Honorific appellate designation for an advocate or barrister appearing before the Court.

entries.ruleNote: Initial S-circle attaches to Per-Em (Supreme), intersected by Kay-Ar halved for T (Court) on the baseline.
entries.legalDefinition: The apex constitutional court of Pakistan whose law declarations bind all courts under Article 189.

entries.ruleNote: Upward Hay placed in 1st position for diphthong 'i', intersected perpendicularly by Kay (Court).
entries.legalDefinition: Principal provincial constitutional and appellate court exercising writ (Art. 199) and revisional jurisdiction.

entries.ruleNote: Initial 'con-' dot is omitted; horizontal Kay joins a crisp Stee loop and final -tion hook on the baseline.
entries.legalDefinition: Supreme fundamental law of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan establishing state organs and Fundamental Rights.

entries.ruleNote: Heavy downward Jay passes through the ruled line (3rd Pos for 'oo'), flowing into Ar, medial S-circle, Kay, and -tion hook.
entries.legalDefinition: Lawful authority conferred upon a court or statutory tribunal to hear and adjudicate a dispute.

entries.ruleNote: Light downward Pee intersected by Tee (P-T) denotes petition/petitioner in rapid court reporting.
entries.legalDefinition: Party initiating a constitutional writ, civil revision, or special leave petition seeking judicial relief.

entries.ruleNote: Ef with En-hook halved for D joins abbreviated Ray halved for T with final S-circle in 1st position.
entries.legalDefinition: Inalienable constitutional protections (Articles 8-28) enforceable directly against state action.

entries.ruleNote: Connective 'of' is omitted by phrasing principles directly into En-Cher-El (natural) and Jay-Es (justice).
entries.legalDefinition: Core fairness rules: nemo judex in causa sua and audi alteram partem.

entries.ruleNote: Heavy Dee through the line (3rd Pos for 'ew') links straight into Per-hook and large final Ses-circle (-cess).
entries.legalDefinition: Constitutional fair-trial guarantee under Article 10-A requiring notice and impartial adjudication.

entries.ruleNote: Bee-En-Ef-Tee links directly to heavy Dee halved for T (doubt), omitting 'of' in criminal trial reporting.
entries.legalDefinition: Mandatory criminal-law rule requiring acquittal whenever a single reasonable doubt dents the prosecution story.

entries.ruleNote: Per-hook descends from 1st position, turns an S-circle into horizontal Kay, and closes with a -tion hook.
entries.legalDefinition: The State or complainant conducting criminal proceedings against an accused person.

entries.ruleNote: Em-Pee-Gay-En halved for D joins Pitman's iconic Jay-Jay contraction (judgment) on the line.
entries.legalDefinition: Contested judicial decision of a lower forum challenged in appeal or revision.

entries.ruleNote: S-Pee-S-Ef-Kay is intersected by Per-Ef (performance) for civil equity dictation.
entries.legalDefinition: Equitable decree under the Specific Relief Act compelling exact performance of a valid contract.

entries.theoryPrinciple: Initial Tr-Hook + Final En-Hook & Upward El
entries.ruleNote: Tee with R-hook flows into heavy Bee, medial En-hook, and upward El in 1st position.
entries.legalDefinition: Specialized quasi-judicial body constituted under statute to adjudicate service, tax, or regulatory disputes.

entries.ruleNote: Heavy Dee joins S-circle turned inside the Kr-hook curve, finishing with a large -tion hook.
entries.legalDefinition: Bounded legal power to choose among lawful courses guided by sound judicial principles.

entries.ruleNote: Downward Ar-Bee-Tee is doubled in length for '-tral/-ter', paired with halved Way-Ar for 'award'.
entries.legalDefinition: Binding final decision rendered by an arbitral tribunal in commercial or international disputes.

entries.ruleNote: Way-El-S-Tee-El halved for D joins without pen lift into Per-En-S-Pee-El ('principle').
entries.legalDefinition: Authoritative rule established by consistent superior court precedent binding subordinate forums.

entries.ruleNote: Written phonetically by sound: El-Kay-Es followed by Pee-En-Tee halved with final Ish-vowel.
entries.legalDefinition: Doctrine barring rescission of an administrative order once decisive steps create vested civil rights.

entries.ruleNote: Per-Em in 1st position followed by downward Ef and Ish writes 'prima facie' cleanly without vocalization.
entries.legalDefinition: Sufficient evidence on the face of the record to establish a case or warrant interim relief unless rebutted.

entries.ruleNote: Upward El doubled to express '-tra' joins heavy Vee-Ar with final S-circle for 'ultra vires'.
entries.legalDefinition: Act, rule, or notification enacted beyond the lawful statutory or constitutional powers of an authority.

entries.ruleNote: Upward Ray with S-circle precedes heavy Jay-Dee-Kay halved for final T (Section 11 CPC).
entries.legalDefinition: Bar preventing re-litigation of a matter already finally decided on merits between the same parties.

entries.ruleNote: Upward Hay joins heavy Bee with final S-circle, phrased before Kr-hook Pee-S.
entries.legalDefinition: Constitutional writ or order under Section 491 Cr.P.C. directing production of a detainee to test legality of custody.

entries.ruleNote: Because two vowels follow initial S in 'suo', full Es-stroke is used in 3rd position before halved Em.
entries.legalDefinition: Jurisdiction exercised on the Court's own motion in matters of public importance involving Fundamental Rights.

entries.ruleNote: Ray halved for T omits 'of' and pairs with Em-En halved for D followed by Em with S-circle.
entries.legalDefinition: Constitutional writ commanding a public functionary to perform a mandatory statutory duty.

entries.ruleNote: Heavy horizontal Gay flows into heavy downward Vee with N-hook on the baseline.
entries.legalDefinition: Executive organ of the federation or province exercising statutory and policy powers.

entries.ruleNote: Per-hook starts above the line (1st Pos 'ah'), joins upward El and abbreviated Em-En halved for T.
entries.legalDefinition: Federal legislature exercising law-making, budgetary approval, and executive oversight.

entries.ruleNote: Upward El flows into heavy Jay, turns an S-circle into upward El, and finishes with a large -tion hook.
entries.legalDefinition: Enacted statute law or delegated rules promulgated under parliamentary authority.

entries.theoryPrinciple: Halved K-N-T + Disjoined B (-bility Suffix Rule)
entries.ruleNote: Halved Kay with N-hook writes 'account', followed by a closely disjoined heavy Bee for '-bility'.
entries.legalDefinition: Institutional obligation of state organs to justify executive actions and public expenditure.
